reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative: Food insecurity in Haiti is at record levels, with 4,9 million people facing acute food insecurity. Through the distribution of school meals, the project will provide immediate assistance to school aged children in food insecure areas of Haiti that have been impacted by the latest complex crisis in the country, while also contributing to strengthening the local food systems. The planned effects for the target group are to reach 8150 school aged children with a daily meal for 80 school days across appx. 40 schools in Haiti’s Great South, while providing “Vita Mamba” snacks to 20.000 children in the West department. The project also aims to provide locally sources products and improve the quality and quantity of local peanut production in the North East department and capacity strengthening of smallholder farmers. The target of the project is to aim to have at least 51% women smallholder farmers members in the agricultural production organizations. Capacity strengthening activities include the promotion of gender sensitive material, promotion of equal access to credit, as well as direct access to technical knowledge to women to promote equal access to markets.
